CalcExpress

Owning Palette: CalcExpress Toolkit

This palette contains CalcExpress VIs.

 

Palette Object Description
[ce] CalcExpress - Abort Evaluation.vi Aborts evaluation of a CalcExpress script associated with CE InstanceRef.
[ce] CalcExpress - Close Instance.vi Destroys a dynamic CalcExpress instance context or reinitializes a static instance context.
[ce] CalcExpress - Diagnose Script.vi Returns the names of variables and functions referenced in a CalcExpress expression or sequential script. To analyze a parsed script, pass a reference to its instance context to CE InstanceRef control; otherwise, pass a script source to expression control.
[ce] CalcExpress - Eval Script.vi Evaluates previously parsed CalcExpress expressions and sequential scripts. To process non-sequential scripts that contain loops and conditional branching, use CSE VIs.
[ce] CalcExpress - Not a CE InstanceRef.vi Validates a reference to a CalcExpress instance context.
[ce] CalcExpress - Parse Script.vi Parses CalcExpress expressions and sequential scripts. A parsed script can be executed using a CalcExpress evaluator VI. To process non-sequential scripts that contain loops and conditional branching, use CSE VIs.
[ce] CalcExpress - Variables Writer ID.vi Use this VI to preset the writer ID used by the given CE Instance for writing to variables during execution. The writer ID can also be modified using the vwrid(wrid) function in an expression/script.
[ce] CalcExpress Light.vi Evaluates CalcExpress expressions and sequential scripts. To process non-sequential scripts that contain loops and conditional branching, use CSE VIs.
[ce] CalcExpress.vi Evaluates CalcExpress expressions and sequential scripts. To process non-sequential scripts that contain loops and conditional branching, use CSE VIs.

 

Subpalette Description
FuncVI Development VIs for developing FuncVIs (CalcExpress functions implemented as VIs).
FuncVI Service VIs to support using FuncVIs in applications.
